Title: Amber Tide Bowl
Body (HTML):
A free-form bowl that ripples and folds like fabric caught in a breeze. Deep cobalt blue swirls through warm amber, gold and copper-brown, and the colours shift as you walk around it.

This is a decorative piece.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Crystal Confetti Bowl
Body (HTML):
A clear bowl packed with flakes of opal-like shimmer in gold, teal, pink and orange, with a bubbly, lace-like rim.

It changes completely with the light and what's behind it. Against white it looks icy and delicate, like frost on a window. Set it on something dark and the flakes glow fiery orange and gold. The photos show both, so you can see the range.

This is a decorative piece.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Forest Stream Platter
Body (HTML):
A long free-form platter in mossy gold and teal, crackled like lichen on a forest floor. A stream of sparkling green and gold glass runs down the middle, and the edges ripple and fold all the way round.

This is a decorative piece. The crushed glass is set firmly in the resin, but its edges are real glass, so handle it with care.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Midnight Gold Platter
Body (HTML):
A round platter with a wide, striped natural rim, its centre filled with deep cobalt blue resin laced with gold, bronze and copper cells. It took two pours to build up the colour and depth.

Janet found the platter secondhand and gave it a new life, so it's one-of-a-kind twice over.

This is a decorative piece.
